description: This file defines a Pinia store for authentication management in a frontend application, including state, getters, and actions for login, logout, and user management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sets the user and token in the store, used for user login.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user and token data from the store, used for user logout.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Updates the user information stored in the auth store.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Updates the token in the auth store.
